items.summary: Add src/repo/index.ts barrel, relocate sanitize-utils into src/vcs/, move unified-summary.ts to src/cli/, and stage test/unit/ mirror migration in four validate-after-each steps

members.summary: src/repo/ is the only production domain folder without an index.ts barrel; detector.ts re-exports serve as a makeshift substitute
src/shared/sanitize-utils.ts has 100% of production importers inside src/vcs/ — misplaced in shared-kernel
test/unit/ mirrors src/ structure inconsistently — 57 flat files coexist with 6 domain subdirectories
Test files use flat kebab-case names in test/unit/ instead of mirroring src/ directory structure, obscuring coverage-to-source mapping
output/unified-summary.ts is a CLI-only multi-report stitcher living among the generic per-domain output formatters

action_steps.title: Add src/repo/index.ts barrel and redirect imports away from detector.ts
action_steps.detail: src/repo/ currently has detector.ts, metadata-provider.ts, types.ts, utils.ts but no barrel file. Create a new barrel (index.ts) in src/repo/ re-exporting from src/repo/types.ts (RepoInfo and platform-specific variants), src/repo/utils.ts (isGitHubRepo, assertGitHubRepo, getRepoDisplayName), src/repo/detector.ts (detectRepoInfo), and src/repo/metadata-provider.ts (GitHubRepoMetadataProvider plus IRepoMetadataProvider). Redirect the ~43 importers of '../repo/detector.js' under src/cli/, src/sync/, and src/vcs/ to the new barrel where appropriate.

action_steps.title: Relocate sanitize-utils into src/vcs/ and move unified-summary into src/cli/
action_steps.detail: git mv src/shared/sanitize-utils.ts into src/vcs/ and update the three src/vcs/github-pr-strategy.ts, src/vcs/azure-pr-strategy.ts, src/vcs/gitlab-pr-strategy.ts imports (plus test/unit/sanitize-utils.test.ts). git mv src/output/unified-summary.ts into src/cli/ and update src/cli/sync-command.ts import. Note: src/output/ currently has no index.ts barrel, so no re-export cleanup needed there.

action_steps.title: Stage test/unit/ directory migration to mirror src/ in four validated batches
action_steps.detail: Run npm test between each batch: (1) vcs tests move into test/unit/vcs/; (2) settings tests (ruleset/labels/repo-settings/code-scanning diff/formatter/processor) move into test/unit/settings/<kind>/; (3) shared-utility tests move into test/unit/shared/; (4) verify no remaining flat-root tests for modules that already have a subdirectory.
